Method.Implementation: Set depCl = ##class(SrcCtrlDeploymentInfoWebService.SrcCtrlDeploymentInfoWebServiceSoap).%New() Set depCl.Username = %session.Data("srcHistUsrNm") Set depCl.Password = %session.Data("srcHistPsWd") #;set Username = %session.Data("srcHistUsrNm") #;set Password = %session.Data("srcHistPsWd") Set depCl.SSLConfiguration = "DeployClientService" Try { Do depCl.WSSecurityLogin(depCl.Username,depCl.Password) } Catch ex { Set errorMsg = "Error: "_ex.DisplayString() Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFileWithUserNm($USERNAME, errorMsg) } Try { Set depCl.Location = ..WSLocation Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFileWithUserNm($USERNAME,depCl.Location) Set compImpl = depCl.GetLastImplementationDetails(tItemName, env, nmSp) Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFileWithUserNm($USERNAME,"compImpl contains: "_ compImpl) Set tExportClsFilename = $PIECE(compImpl, ";", 1) Set rev = $PIECE(compImpl, ";", 2) Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFileWithUserNm($USERNAME,"rev: "_rev_" filename: "_tExportClsFilename_" Impl Date: "_$PIECE(compImpl, ";", 3)) Set details = ""_ rev _""_ $PIECE(compImpl, ";", 3)_""_ tExportClsFilename _"" #;Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFileWithUserNm(details) } Catch(err) { Set errorMsg = "Error: "_err.DisplayString() Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFileWithUserNm($USERNAME, errorMsg) Set details = "--Not deployed" } Return details

Method.name: CheckInDepPkg
Method.Implementation:
Do ##class(IHC.ITF.SrcCtrlPkg.EnsembleSrcCtrlClass).CheckSvnSetup($GET(%session.Data("UsNm")), $GET(%session.Data("PsWd"))) Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFileWithUserNm($GET(%session.Data("UsNm")), "CheckInDepPkg: " _ aikb)
Set statStr = "" Set crFl = ##class(IHC.ITF.SrcCtrlPkg.CreateDeploymentPackage).%New()
Set fileNm = crFl.DeployDirectory _ crFl.DeploymentPackageDirec _ aikb _".txt"
Set file = ##class(%File).%New(fileNm) Set stat = file.Open("R") Do file.Close() If ($$$ISOK(stat)) { Do file.Close() Set stat = crFl.checkDeploymentPackageInFiles(aikb, cmt, $GET(%session.Data("UsNm")), $GET(%session.Data("PsWd")), .statStr) Set retStr = "CheckIn File output: " _ stat _ "; " _ statStr } Else { Set retStr = "Please create the Deployment Package file: " _ fileNm }
Return retStr
